Reworded 2026-10-04 (appendix pass) in section 4.1's terms: co-occurrence
mining, keyword mining, attack flows, edges between tactics. DRAFT STATE,
question: How is dependency between tactics obtained?

modes.name: Co-occurrence mining
modes.rests_on: the same APT group or tool uses both techniques
modes.direction_from: an assumed order of the tactics
modes.why_not: Using two techniques together says nothing about which came first, and an assumed order allows no edge back.

modes.name: Keyword mining
modes.rests_on: one technique's ATT&CK description names the other
modes.direction_from: an assumed order of the tactics
modes.why_not: A description that names another technique refers to it; it does not say the attacker needs it first.

modes.name: Attack flows
modes.rests_on: an analyst drew one step after the other

not_attempted.note: ruled out on the literature and never run, named here so the table cannot be read as reporting them.

_why: The shipped L1 (v0.5) resolves on this project's 15-tactic axis, which splits
ATT&CK's defense-evasion into stealth and defense-impairment. The superseded
v0.4 profile resolves on stock ATT&CK's 14. Folding the split back is what
makes the caption's shipped figure comparable with the table body instead of
quoting two coverage fractions against two different denominators.
